Fridge reel, recaptioned

Eight moments from the Alexandr Wang fridge reel with the captions redone in the new design system. Frames come from the locked talking-head cut and the clean B-roll clips, so nothing from the old captions shows through.

Primary on every word (GT Standard, shown in Inter) Accent on the one key word (HW Cigars, shown in Newsreader) Block flash on a single word, a few times per reel All captions inside the Reels safe zone

Timecodes marked ≈ are approximate B-roll slots on the 52.76 s cut. The same eight frames are in Figma on the Reel templates page as "Storyboard / Fridge reel / captions v1", built from the design system's caption components.
